title: zeltnera davyi
intro: Zeltnera davyi, commonly known as Davy's penstemon or penstemon davyi, is a perennial plant species in the family Gentianaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties, which help to loosen and clear mucus from the lungs. The therapeutic actions of Zeltnera davyi include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, which can help to soothe and calm the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and gentiopicrin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
